proteins_are: Accessions with evidence that passed acceptance (an accepted protein group OR an accepted peptidoform) in at least one dataset; decoys excluded, contaminants kept and labelled PER DATASET, because the label is: human albumin is a target in a human search and a contaminant in a rodent one. `best_protein_group_q_value` is NULL where only a peptidoform passed, so a listed dataset is not 'identified at 1% protein FDR'. An accession absent from its shard had no accepted evidence anywhere in this catalog.
